verdict.rationale: Motion's meeting assistant lets you build a separate template for each scenario (client calls, sales demos, and so on), each with its own duration, pre-meeting questions and reminders. Prospects book these through an embeddable booking calendar, and video conferencing links are added automatically. Missing for 10: per-event-type location settings beyond auto-added video links, confirmation/approval rules per event type, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
